I don't have a record of Mira's first steps in her history — I can see milestones like stacking three blocks and pulling to standing at the couch, but nothing logged specifically for first independent steps.

If you remember roughly when it happened, tell me and I'll save it so it's tracked going forward. Otherwise, this might be worth jotting down at your next Riverdale Pediatrics visit if you want it on record.
